text:
lara: urgent — customer-facing embed requests returning 500s since 09:42 UTC. Hotfix branch hotfix/embeds-500-fix ready. Requesting expedited approval to skip the 15m canary and push to prod now. Impacting a paid account, customer oncall paged.

deploy-bot: Deploy request created: hotfix/embeds-500-fix -> prod
- commit: ab12c9f
- image: redwood/embeds:hotfix-ab12c9f
- pipeline: build -> smoke -> canary(15m) -> rollout
- flagged: expedite=true, reason=prod-500s

aj: what's the rollback plan? any schema changes or risky stateful work?

lara: no schema changes, pure codepath fix. Rollback plan: revert to tag prod@2026-03-20-rc3 (image redwood/embeds:prod-rc3), automated rollback script prepped at /ops/scripts/rollback_embed.sh. Smoke tests are the usual: /ops/test/smoke_embed.sh

sre-oncall: we can make an exception to skip canary if we get: 1) full smoke green, 2) 5m of real-traffic sampling with trace IDs captured, 3) immediate rollback button primed. I'll stand by during the window. I can reserve extra log retention for 30m.

morgan: product +1 — customer impact is severe, they need this sooner rather than later. Will send the incident banner once we have a deploy timestamp.

kevin: quick risk note — skipping canary increases blast radius, but given no migrations and a tested revert path I'm OK if SRE keeps close watch. +1 from me.

aj: OK from eng leadership. Conditions accepted: smoke pass + 5m sampling + rollback ready. Approving expedited deploy (skip canary). +1

deploy-bot: Approvals recorded: aj, kevin, sre-oncall. Proceeding with pipeline using expedite=true. Executing: build -> smoke -> (skip canary) -> rollout.

deploy-bot: smoke stage logs:
```
[smoke] check embeddings endpoint /v1/embeds -> 200 OK
[smoke] sample inference x10 -> latency < 120ms
[smoke] health checks OK
```

deploy-bot: Smoke passed. Beginning prod rollout with expedited policy (canary skipped). Notifying watchers.

sre-oncall: live sampling started — tracing IDs: trace=tr_9a1d... sampling window 5m. I will trigger rollback if error_rate > 2x baseline or p95 latency regresses > 2x.

deploy-bot: Rolling to prod... stage: 20% -> 100% (skipped canary)

deploy-bot: Rollout success. All pods upgraded. Post-deploy metrics: error rate back to baseline, embeddings errors 0, latency stable.

lara: thanks everyone. Filing a short postmortem and adding a note in release notes: "hotfix: fixes 500s on embeds, expedited deployment with SRE oversight". Notifying the affected customer now.

morgan: I'll send the customer note (brief outage + action taken) and update the incident banner.

sre-oncall: I'll keep monitoring for the next 30 min and then clear the expedite exception. Good job team. :thumbsup:
